info.title: Kedem Life API
info.description:
REST API for the Kedem Life studio platform: authentication, member directory, specialist booking, member progress, storefront, orders, payments, memberships and studio administration.

**Conventions**
- All paths are relative to `/api`. Requests and responses are JSON (bodies up to 256 kB).
- Authentication is a JWT sent as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`, obtained from `POST /auth/login`, `POST /auth/register` or `POST /auth/refresh`. Access tokens last 12 h (30 days with `rememberMe`); refresh tokens last 30 days and are single-use.
- The bearer token is read on every request, including public routes: a malformed or expired token yields 401 and a suspended account yields 403 (`code: "suspended"`) even where no token was required. The user row is re-read each request, so role changes and suspensions apply immediately.
- Errors are RFC 7807 Problem Details (`application/problem+json`): `{ type, title, status, detail, code?, errors? }`. Zod validation failures are 422 with `code: "validation"` and per-field `errors`. Unknown routes are 404 problems. MySQL duplicate keys surface as 409.
- Rate limits (per IP, 15-minute window): 30 requests across `/auth/login`, `/auth/register`, `/auth/password-reset` and `/auth/password-reset/confirm`; 10 requests across `/contact` and `/newsletter`. Exceeding them returns 429 with `RateLimit`, `RateLimit-Policy` and `Retry-After` headers.
- Handlers that return nothing answer 204 with an empty body. Some lookups deliberately return `200` with a JSON `null` body instead of 404 (single directory profile, provider, product by slug, order) so the front end can render its own empty state.

**Roles and permissions** (src/domain.ts `ROLE_PERMISSIONS`)
- `member`: progress:read:self, appointments:write
- `coach`: + progress:read:assigned, orders:read
- `admin`: + payments:read, catalog:write, tenant:write
- `app_manager`: + platform:write (everything, across all studios)

post.description: Exchanges email + password for an access/refresh token pair. Rate limited: 30 requests per 15 minutes per IP (shared with register and the password-reset routes). Checks run in this order: credentials (400 invalid_credentials), account status (403 suspended), portal (403 wrong_portal), then tenantSlug (400 invalid_credentials on mismatch). Portal acceptance: member -> member; coach -> coach; admin -> admin or app_manager; app_manager -> app_manager.

400.description: Unknown email, wrong password, or the account is not in the named studio (code invalid_credentials).

example.title: Bad Request
example.detail: That email and password combination is not recognised.

403.description: Account suspended (code suspended) or the account role is not accepted by the requested portal (code wrong_portal).

example.title: Forbidden
example.detail: These credentials belong to a coach account. Use the matching sign-in page.

post.description: Registers a new member (the role is always member) in the named studio, or the default studio when tenantSlug is omitted, and signs them in. The new member is assigned to the studio's longest-serving active coach. Rate limited: 30 per 15 minutes per IP.

post.description: Requires a valid bearer token. Revokes every refresh token of the current session. The access token itself stays valid until it expires, so clients should discard it.

post.description: Requires a valid bearer token. Books the caller with a provider at one of the provider's published slots. The provider must be active and accepting bookings and (unless the caller is app_manager) in the caller's studio. The booking is created as "confirmed" at the provider's session rate. Bookings are serialised per provider inside a transaction; a race for the same slot ends in 409. Phone sessions get a tel: joinUrl; other channels have none yet.

post.summary: Place and pay for an order
post.description: Requires a valid bearer token. Creates the order, charges it through the configured payment provider (currently "manual", which always succeeds) and records the payment, all in one transaction; on success the order is "paid". Totals are recomputed server-side: shipping is 795 minor units unless every line is digital or the subtotal reaches 12500; tax is 8.25 %. Any line in the membership category also starts a monthly subscription (unless one is already active for that product).

409.description: A product is out of stock (code out_of_stock) or the charge was declined (code payment_failed).

bearerAuth.description: accessToken from /auth/login, /auth/register or /auth/refresh. Claims: sub (user id), role, tid (tenant id), sid (session id).

Role.description: Account role. Portals: member -> member; coach -> coach; admin -> admin or app_manager; app_manager -> app_manager.

title.description: HTTP reason phrase for the status.

status.description: HTTP status code, repeated in the body.

detail.description: Human-readable message; the front end shows this to the user.

code.description: Machine-readable reason, present only for specific failures: invalid_credentials, wrong_portal, suspended, email_taken, seats_full, reset_invalid, out_of_stock, payment_failed, already_subscribed, validation.

errors.description: Field-level messages, keyed by dotted field path ("_" when the issue has no path). Present on 422 validation failures and some 422 business-rule failures.

Problem.description: RFC 7807 Problem Details. Every error response uses Content-Type application/problem+json.

examples: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

RateLimited.description: Body sent by express-rate-limit when a per-IP budget is exhausted. Sent as application/json (not problem+json) and without the "type" member. RateLimit, RateLimit-Policy and Retry-After headers accompany it.

amountMinor.description: Amount in the currency's minor unit (cents, pence, paise).

title.description: Job title for staff; the sign-up "goal" text for members.

UserProfile.description: A person. Optional members are omitted (not null) when the row has no value; avatarUrl and assignedCoachId are always present and may be null. The password hash is never returned.
